integration_removed.title: The SunWEG integration has been removed
integration_removed.description:
The SunWEG integration has been removed from SmartHub.

The library that SmartHub uses to connect with SunWEG services, [doesn't work as expected anymore, demanding daily token renew]({issue}).

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your SmartHub setup. [Click here to see your existing SunWEG integration entries]({entries}).
